source_quote: Under these conditions, we observed a ~ 200-fold increase in survival in the + UV group at the 200 J/m 2 secondary exposure.
notes: Double-exposure protocol: response is the ratio of survival in UV-pre-exposed (+UV) cells to survival in mock-pre-exposed (-UV) cells receiving the SAME secondary dose; it is not survival relative to unirradiated cells. dose_value is the secondary UV dose. Pre-exposure 50 J/m2, 4 h incubation at 30 C before the secondary exposure. UV at 254 nm (Philips 30 W G30T8 lamp); colonies counted after 6 days at 30 C. Absolute survival percentages appear only in figures.

source_quote: Fold increased survival in + UV cells relative to −UV cells gradually diminished with extended incubation time, reaching a low of twofold after 16 h (at 200 J/m 2 secondary exposure), and completely disappearing at 22 h.
notes: Double-exposure protocol: response is the ratio of survival in UV-pre-exposed (+UV) cells to survival in mock-pre-exposed (-UV) cells receiving the SAME secondary dose; it is not survival relative to unirradiated cells. dose_value is the secondary UV dose. Pre-exposure 50 J/m2, 16 h incubation before the secondary exposure; effect gone by 22 h. UV at 254 nm (Philips 30 W G30T8 lamp); colonies counted after 6 days at 30 C. Absolute survival percentages appear only in figures.

source_quote: We observed that the pre-exposed daughter cells (+ UV) exhibited significantly increased survival following the second UV exposure relative to the unexposed (−UV) control population, with a 40-fold increase in survival (Fig. 2 a).
notes: Double-exposure protocol: response is the ratio of survival in UV-pre-exposed (+UV) cells to survival in mock-pre-exposed (-UV) cells receiving the SAME secondary dose; it is not survival relative to unirradiated cells. dose_value is the secondary UV dose. Pre-exposure 50 J/m2; biotin-sorted daughter cells only (mother cells removed), demonstrating mitotic inheritance. UV at 254 nm (Philips 30 W G30T8 lamp); colonies counted after 6 days at 30 C. Absolute survival percentages appear only in figures.
